## Visualize MAE of predictors as performance evaluation


```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)

colors <- c(
    "Glucose"   = "#56B4E9",
    "Glucose+\nRibose"    = "#CC79A7",
    "Glucose+\nThymidine" = "#D55E00",
    "Glucose+\nAdenosine" = "#009E73",
    "Glucose+\nUridine"   = "#E69F00",
    "Glucose+\nCytidine"  = "#0072B2"
)

theme_dbt <- function() {
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    )
}

dir.create(file.path(here("Output/plot_maes_preds/")), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Ecoli predictor MAEs

preds_ecoli <- read_csv(here("Output/species_comparison_flux_ratio_prediction/Ecoli/predictions.csv")) %>% 
    select(-"...1") %>% 
    mutate(model = "Ecoli")


preds_buni <- read_csv(here("Output/species_comparison_flux_ratio_prediction/BuniPvul/predictions.csv")) %>% 
    select(-"...1") %>% 
    mutate(model = "Buni")

all_maes <- bind_rows(preds_ecoli, preds_buni) %>% 
    complete(condition, flux_ratio, model) %>%
    select(condition, flux_ratio, model, mae) %>% 
    unique()


best_preds <- all_maes %>% 
    group_by(flux_ratio, model) %>% 
    arrange(mae) %>% 
    slice_head(n=1) %>% 
    rename("label" = "mae")
    

maes2 <- all_maes %>% 
    left_join(best_preds, by = c("condition", "flux_ratio", "model")) %>% 
    mutate(label = as.character(round(label, 2))) %>% 
    mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(label), "", label)) %>% 
    mutate(ratio = factor(flux_ratio, levels = rev(levels(factor(all_maes$flux_ratio))))) %>% 
    mutate(condition = factor(
        condition, 
        levels = c("Glc_100_U13C", "Glc_100_113C", "Glc_50_U13C_50_113C"), 
        labels = c("100% U13C", "100% 1-13C", "50% U13C 50% 113C"))
    ) %>% 
    mutate(flux_ratio = gsub("_", " ", flux_ratio))
    
ggplot(maes2 %>% filter(model == "Ecoli"), aes(y = ratio, x = condition, fill = mae)) + 
    geom_tile() + 
    geom_text(aes(label = label,
                  color = mae > 0.1)) + 
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "mae", option = "viridis", direction = -1, limits = c(0,0.27)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white",
                                  "FALSE" = "black"),
                       guide = "none") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    theme_bw() + 
    facet_wrap(~model) + 
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 20, hjust = 1), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15)

    ) + 
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("") + 
    plot_layout(widths = unit(5, "cm"), heights = unit(8, "cm"))
    
    
ggsave(
    filename = "heatmapEcoli.pdf", 
    path = here("Output/plot_maes_preds/"),
    width = 5,
    height = 4.5
)

   
ggplot(maes2 %>% filter(model == "Buni"), aes(y = ratio, x = condition, fill = mae)) + 
    geom_tile() + 
    geom_text(aes(label = label,
                  color = mae > 0.1)) + 
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "mae", option = "viridis", direction = -1, limits = c(0,0.27)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white",
                                  "FALSE" = "black"),
                       guide = "none") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    theme_bw() + 
    facet_wrap(~model) + 
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 20, hjust = 1), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    ) + 
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("") + 
    plot_layout(widths = unit(5, "cm"), heights = unit(8, "cm"))

    
ggsave(
    filename = "heatmapBuni.pdf", 
    path = here("Output/plot_maes_preds/"),
    width = 5,
    height = 4.5
)


```

# Visualise prediction + intervals

based on the evaluation above, we select the best predictors and 

```{r}

colors <- c(
            "Buni" = "#ef476f", 
            "Ecoli" = "#118ab2",
            "Pvul" = "#06d6a0"         
        )
        
glc_conds <- c("Glc_100_U13C", "Glc_100_113C", "Glc_50_U13C_50_113C")     

all_preds <- bind_rows(preds_ecoli, preds_buni) %>% 
    complete(condition, flux_ratio, model) %>%
    select(condition, flux_ratio, model, pred, pred_q10, pred_q90, strain) %>% 
    unique()


preds_bestpred <- all_preds %>% 
    filter((strain == "Ecoli" & model == "Ecoli") | (strain %in% c("Buni", "Pvul") & model == "Buni")) %>% 
    inner_join(best_preds, by = c("condition", "flux_ratio", "model")) %>% 
    mutate(condition = factor(
        condition, 
        levels = c("Glc_100_U13C", "Glc_100_113C", "Glc_50_U13C_50_113C"), 
        labels = c("100% U13C", "100% 1-13C", "50% U13C 50% 113C"))
    ) %>% 
    mutate(flux_ratio = gsub("_", " ", flux_ratio))
    

ggplot(preds_bestpred, aes(x = flux_ratio, y = pred, group = strain, color = strain)) + 
    
    # facet_grid(~model) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pred_q10, ymax = pred_q90), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), color = "black", width = 0) +  
    geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    ylim(0,1) + 
    theme_bw() + 
    coord_flip() + 
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) + 
    theme_dbt() +
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("") + 
    plot_layout(widths = unit(6, "cm"), heights = unit(8, "cm"))

    

ggsave(
    filename = "best_preds_mean.pdf", 
    path = here("Output/plot_maes_preds/"),
    width = 6,
    height = 4.5
)    

        
```

# Plot maes and predictors of B. uniformis nucleoside co-feeding

```{r}

shapes <- c(
    "nucleoside MDV\nprovided as input" = 16, 
    "no nucleoside MDV\nprovided as input" = 17, 
    "all MDVs in\nglucose condition" = 15, 
    "MDV overlap of glucose\nand co-feed condition" = 18
)

cofeed_preds <- list.files(path = here("Output/CofeedBuni/"))

cofeed_preds <- cofeed_preds[grepl("predictions", cofeed_preds)]

preds_cofeed <- bind_rows(lapply((paste0(here("Output/CofeedBuni/"), cofeed_preds)), \(x) read_csv(x))) %>% 
    mutate(model = factor(condition, levels = c("Adenosine", "Cytidine", "Thymidine","Uridine"), labels = c("Glucose+\nAdenosine", "Glucose+\nCytidine", "Glucose+\nThymidine", "Glucose+\nUridine"))) %>% 
    filter(feature_subset == TRUE) %>% 
    mutate("Feature Set" = factor(comparison, levels = c("full_sel", "wo nuc sel", "glc_sel", "both_sel"), labels = c("nucleoside MDV\nprovided as input", "no nucleoside MDV\nprovided as input", "all MDVs in\nglucose condition", "MDV overlap of glucose\nand co-feed condition"))) %>% 
    mutate(flux_ratio = gsub(".*_", "", flux_ratio)) %>% 
    mutate(label = as.character(round(mae, 2))) %>% 
    mutate(flux_ratio = factor(flux_ratio, levels = c("ccm", "phos", "uptake"), labels = c("Ribose\ncleavage", "Phosphorylation", "Uptake")))
# plot MAEs

preds_cofeed_noglc <- preds_cofeed %>% 
    filter(condition != "Glucose")

ggplot(preds_cofeed_noglc, aes(x = model, y = flux_ratio, fill = mae)) + 
    geom_tile() + 
    geom_text(aes(label = label,
                  color = round(mae, 2) > 0.1), size = 5) + 
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "MAE", option = "viridis", direction = -1, limits = c(0,0.27)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white",
                                  "FALSE" = "black"),
                       guide = "none") +
    theme_bw() + 
    facet_wrap(.~`Feature Set`) +
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    ) + 
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("") + 
    plot_layout(widths = unit(12, "cm"), heights = unit(7, "cm"))

ggsave(
    filename = "maes_cofeed.pdf", 
    path = here("Output/plot_maes_preds/"),
    width = 8,
    height = 6
)    
```

# Plot flux ratio predictions from real samples

```{r}
# select appropriate predictions and make a lineplot similar to what I had previously

preds_cofeed_sel <- preds_cofeed %>% 
    filter(condition != "Glucose") %>% 
    group_by(condition, flux_ratio, nucleoside) %>% 
    arrange(mae, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(rank = row_number())
    
preds_switch <- preds_cofeed_sel %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    filter(comparison %in% c("wo nuc sel") & mae < 0.1) %>% 
    select(condition, flux_ratio, comparison, nucleoside) %>% 
    mutate(changerank = TRUE) %>% 
    unique()

preds_cofeed_sel <- preds_cofeed_sel %>% 
    left_join(preds_switch, by = c("condition", "flux_ratio", "comparison", "nucleoside")) %>% 
    mutate(changerank = ifelse(is.na(changerank), FALSE, TRUE)) %>% 
    group_by(condition, flux_ratio, comparison) %>% 
    mutate(rank = ifelse(changerank == TRUE, 0, rank))
    
# filter lowest-ranks and plot

preds_lowest <- preds_cofeed_sel %>% 
    group_by(condition, flux_ratio) %>% 
    filter(rank == min(rank)) %>% 
    filter(mae < 0.1) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(flux_ratio, pred, pred_q10, pred_q90, model, condition, `Feature Set`) %>% 
    complete(model, flux_ratio) %>% 
    mutate(condition = ifelse(is.na(condition), gsub("Glucose\\+\\\n", "", model), condition)) %>% 
    mutate(na_label = ifelse(is.na(pred), "N/A", NA))
     
preds_lowest$model <- factor(preds_lowest$model, levels = rev(levels(preds_lowest$model)))

ggplot(preds_lowest, aes(x = pred, y = flux_ratio, color = model, shape = `Feature Set`)) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = pred_q10, xmax = pred_q90, group = model), position = position_dodge(width = 0.65), color = "black", width = 0) +  
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.65), size = 2.5) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0.1, y = flux_ratio, label = na_label, color = model, group = model), position = position_dodge(width = 0.65), color = "black", size = 4) + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) + 
    theme_bw()+
    facet_wrap("co-feed" ~ .) + 
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    ) + 
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("") +
    xlim(0,1) + 
    plot_layout(widths = unit(3, "cm"), heights = unit(6, "cm")) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = "Model") + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapes)
     
ggsave(
    filename = "pred_cofeed_nucl.pdf", 
    path = here("Output/plot_maes_preds/"),
    width = 4,
    height = 4
)    


# plot those of glucose only conditions

preds_cofeed_sel <- preds_cofeed %>% 
    filter(condition == "Glucose") %>% 
    filter(!(is.na(pred))) %>% 
    group_by(condition, flux_ratio, nucleoside) %>% 
    arrange(mae, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(rank = row_number())
    
preds_switch <- preds_cofeed_sel %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    filter(comparison %in% c("wo nuc sel") & mae < 0.1) %>% 
    select(condition, flux_ratio, comparison, nucleoside) %>% 
    mutate(changerank = TRUE) %>% 
    unique()

preds_cofeed_sel <- preds_cofeed_sel %>% 
    left_join(preds_switch, by = c("condition", "flux_ratio", "comparison", "nucleoside")) %>% 
    mutate(changerank = ifelse(is.na(changerank), FALSE, TRUE)) %>% 
    group_by(condition, flux_ratio, comparison) %>% 
    mutate(rank = ifelse(changerank == TRUE, 0, rank))
    

aux <- data.frame(
    nucleoside = c("ADN", "CYTD", "THYMD", "URI"), 
    model = c("Glucose+\nAdenosine", "Glucose+\nCytidine", "Glucose+\nThymidine", "Glucose+\nUridine")
)

nadf <- data.frame(
    model = rep(c("Glucose+\nThymidine"), 3), 
    flux_ratio = factor(c("Ribose\ncleavage", "Phosphorylation", "Uptake")), 
    condition = "Glucose", 
    na_label = "N/A"
)

# filter lowest-ranks and plot

preds_lowest <- preds_cofeed_sel %>% 
    group_by(flux_ratio, nucleoside) %>% 
    filter(rank == min(rank)) %>% 
    select(-model) %>% 
    left_join(aux, by = c("nucleoside")) %>% 
    filter(mae < 0.1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%  
    select(flux_ratio, pred, pred_q10, pred_q90, model, condition, `Feature Set`) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    complete(model, flux_ratio) %>% 
    mutate(condition = "Glucose") %>% 
    mutate(na_label = ifelse(is.na(pred), "N/A", NA)) %>% 
    bind_rows(nadf)
    
     
preds_lowest$model <- factor(preds_lowest$model, levels = rev(c("Glucose+\nAdenosine", "Glucose+\nCytidine", "Glucose+\nThymidine", "Glucose+\nUridine")))


ggplot(preds_lowest, aes(x = pred, y = flux_ratio, color = model, shape = `Feature Set`)) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = pred_q10, xmax = pred_q90, group = model), position = position_dodge(width = 0.65), color = "black", width = 0) +  
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.65), size = 2.5) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0.1, y = flux_ratio, label = na_label, color = model, group = model), position = position_dodge(width = 0.65), color = "black", size = 4) + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) + 
    theme_bw()+
    facet_wrap("glucose only" ~ .) + 
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    ) + 
    xlab("") + 
    ylab("") +
    xlim(0,1) + 
    plot_layout(widths = unit(3, "cm"), heights = unit(6, "cm")) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = "Model") + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapes)
     
ggsave(
    filename = "pred_cofeed_glconly.pdf", 
    path = here("Output/plot_maes_preds/"),
    width = 4,
    height = 4
)    
    
```
